Accessing Native Banner

From the ORA eTraining module "Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration" (lesson 2 of 12).
Native Banner: A Detailed Look At Budget Activity
Accessing Native Banner
This module focuses on functionality in Native Banner as it provides the most detailed views of budget activity, encumbrance detail, and other reports.
How Can I Use Native
In the next lessons of this module we will discuss several pages in Native Banner that will be helpful in tracking your project expenses. Those pages are: FGIBDST (Project Budget by Fiscal Year) FRIGITD (Project Budget Inception to Date) FGIENCD (Project Encumbrance Detail Lookup)
MSU's Home Page
On Morgan's homepage select "My MSU" in the left-side taskbar.
Select Banner/Websis
Select "Banner/Websis".
Enter MSU Credentials
Here, enter your MSU sign-on credentials.
Select Native Banner
On the Banner Links landing page please select "Native Banner" (compass icon).
Note: Potential Login Issue
On occasion the error message above may present on the screen when signing into Native Banner. Please click "okay". You may need to select "Return Home" several times before being redirected to the Native Banner landing page.
Native Banner Landing Page
We've arrived at the landing page for Native Banner! In the next lessons of this module we will discuss several pages in Native Banner that will be helpful in tracking your project expenses. Those pages are: FGIBDST (Project Budget by Fiscal Year) FRIGITD (Project Budget Inception to Date) FGIENCD (Project Encumbrance Detail Lookup) FRIGRNT (Grant Code Inquiry)
Complete the content above before moving on.
